in_sanskrit.name: जल्विका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वज्रिका (Vajrika) + का (Ka) = Jalvika. Vajrika means 'thunderbolt', and Ka means 'with'. So, Jalvika means 'with thunderbolt'.

in_hindi.name: जल्विका
in_hindi.long_meaning: जल (Jal) means 'water' and विका (Vikā) means 'movement' or 'waves'. So, Jalvika could mean 'waves in water' or 'water in motion'.

in_tamil.name: ஜல்விகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜலம் (Jalam) means 'water' and விகா (Vikā) means 'movement' or 'waves'. So, Jalvika could mean 'waves in water' or 'water in motion'.

in_telugu.name: జల్విక
in_telugu.long_meaning: జల (Jalam) means 'water' and విక (Vika) means 'movement' or 'waves'. So, Jalvika could mean 'waves in water' or 'water in motion'.

in_marathi.name: Jalvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of river
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jalvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jalvika is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘jalam’ meaning water and ‘vika’ meaning movement or flow. The name is attributed to the goddess of rivers, evoking the image of a graceful and powerful deity. In Hindu mythology, Jalvika is believed to bring abundance, prosperity, and strength.
